# TasTrips.Online

TasTrips.Online is operated by TASMANIA TRIPS PTY LTD (塔斯马尼亚旅行有限公司).
Service area: Tasmania, Australia.
This GitHub Pages demo currently uses noindex. Do not submit it to Search Console. Replace origin after the official domain is live. Do not invent an ABN.

## Site structure

- `/about` company profile
- `/privacy` `/terms` `/refund` legal pages
- `/trips/routes` day trips and multi-day trips
- `/trips/freeinfo` free reference info (scenic spots, restaurants, lodging, and other public notes). Not a booking or ticket system.
- `/service/ticket` popular attractions and tickets
- `/service/car` private car charter
- `/service/pickup` business transfers
- `/service/guide` local guide
- `/service/steward` trip concierge
- `/service/custom` custom itineraries
- `/info/{itemKey}` content detail pages for trips and reference items

## Do not treat as public landing pages

- `/favorites`
- `/search`
